long_biography.plain_text:
PH Realty Capital, the firm Peter Hungerford founded, specialises in properties that need operational and physical repair. He studied accounting and economics at Syracuse before earning postgraduate degrees in finance and operations research at Columbia. The firm manages its properties directly and supervises construction internally, combining the investment decision with the work needed to reposition each building.

Through Longacre, Hungerford works with Rockledge's principals on larger multifamily acquisitions. The partnership has bought rent-regulated housing in New York and distressed apartment property elsewhere in the United States. Hungerford continues to serve as chief executive of PH Realty and as a managing member of Longacre.
